humanOnly.note: Guardian never runs these and never auto-chains into them; it tells the employee exactly what to type. Only matrix-qa-plugin enforces this with disable-model-invocation — everywhere else it is a text-level rule, so Guardian enforces it.

commands.why: QA engineer approves the test plan (enforced: disable-model-invocation)
QA sign-off of the readiness verdict
duplicate / won't-fix is a human decision

humanOnly.approvalEdits: Flipping a planning document's status (proposed→approved, draft→approved, draft→ready-for-qa) is the employee's decision — never edit it on their behalf.

intents.label: Write a spec (HLD / LLD / SPAC)
intents.notes: Interview-style, one question per turn. Invoke the spec-team-toolkit skill explicitly — "write a SPAC" also matches other spec skills. The toolkit has no repo location of its own (MGA-68/81): in a work repo, tell it to save the documents to docs/specs/<feature-slug>/ (spac_<f>.md, dd_<f>.md, hld-draft.md, scope-list.md, lld-<kind>-<f>.md). The .html preview is not committed. Outside a repo, keep the toolkit default.

resume.note: Probes for "you're at stage X of feature Y". Documents are the source of truth; tool state files are hints. scripts/resume-state.sh implements these deterministically (formats in docs/resume-state.md) and runs at session start; the probes below are the fallback when it is silent or unsure.

ono-mobile-dev-plugin.feature: Find planning docs by YAML frontmatter (doc_schema_version + feature:). No FA → not started · FA status proposed → awaiting approval · DD (*-DD.md) missing/draft → design · Task Breakdown missing/draft → tasks · docs/tasks/<FEATURE>-task-state.json partial → implementing (node --no-warnings "<plugin>/scripts/task-state.ts" read --root <repo> --feature <F> --breakdown <path>) · qa_handoff_link set → QA.
ono-mobile-dev-plugin.bug: docs/bugs/<key>/ exists → node --no-warnings "<plugin>/scripts/analyze-bug.ts" start bug:<key> --root <repo> (status + next_command).

ono-plugin-qa.feature: In the QA repo: no <slug>/test-plan.md → not started · status in the fenced ```yaml block at the top (draft|approved) · approved without coverage-report.md → waiting for dev handoff · then node "<plugin>/scripts/qa-ledger.mjs" view execution|bugs|regression|readiness --scope feature:<slug> --qa-repo <path> (read-only JSON). Never call readiness render/signoff.

matrix-qa-plugin.feature: Glob qa/test-cases/*.md (skip .lld-baseline/) → node "<plugin>/scripts/mqa.mjs" plan state <feature> → {status, effectiveApproval, reason}. DRAFT/CHANGES_REQUIRED → /qa-review · REVIEWED → /qa-approve (human) · reason LLD_CHANGED → /qa-sync · effectiveApproval → /qa-automate then /qa-run.

spec-team-toolkit.spec: Look in docs/specs/*/ (Guardian convention; older specs may be elsewhere — ask). spac_<f>.md "**Status:**" DRAFT|READY; dd_<f>.md present → SPAC is READY; hld-draft.md per-section [סטטוס: …] tags; web/backend LLDs: exists or not.

ono-project-inspector.repo: AUDIT.md topic statuses + CLAUDE.md / docs/project/ existence are the truth; .ono/state.json resume.nextAction is a hint (often stale — its agent can't run bun). Or route to /inspect-status.

gitGuards.note: Org-plugin hooks that block Claude's own git writes. In these repos Guardian hands the exact git / gh commands to the employee (they can run them with the ! prefix) instead of running them.
gitGuards.matrix-qa-plugin: Any repo with matrix-qa.config.json at or above the session folder: every git write and gh pr create is denied (also blocks other repos in the same session). Reported as guards.matrixQa.
gitGuards.ono-plugin-qa: git commit / push blocked in the QA repo: the repo named by .claude/qa-workspace.json qaRepoPath, else any repo whose folder name contains "qa". Reported as guards.onoQaCommitBlocked.
gitGuards.ono-mobile-dev-plugin: Every Write/Edit is blocked on main/master (docs too); code edits ask for approval; secrets in written content are blocked.
